name: RAOfflineProxy
summary: Provides an offline RetroAchievements proxy for supported emulators.

notes: The current Knulli asset is a remote install script and has no publisher-provided checksum; unrestricted scripts are not accepted.
A reviewable archive, exact write paths, H700 compatibility, and real-device testing are required.

evidence.note: Alpha release observed during candidate review; not approved for installation.
